subject: rotp
title: ROTP.------ALT.F.
description: Second diagram on page 489 (TRF(II)-25), paired with (R)INT x PART above. The crossing diagrams how route-options structurally meet alternative-form at the next-cycle power-sharing scale: ROTP (route option) crossed with ALT-F (alternative form). ROTP sits at left with the subject-arrow; ALT-F at lower-center as partner-axis. POL-CON (political consideration) upper-right, ECO-DY (economic dynamics) upper-center, WO-UNF (world unification) right. CULT-AF-BS (cultural-affinity base) right, EXP-DT (expansion dictates) center, C-INFO (central information) center. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and INFO-DY (information dynamics) lower-right. TR (transformation), APL-DT (applied dictates), HI-P (high purpose) form the lower chain. Structural argument: when route-option is crossed with alternative-form, the upper diagonal POL-CON -> ECO-DY -> ROTP shows the partner-axis route - political-consideration and economic-dynamics route into route-options, the partner's working chain. The form's actual alternative-form reaches its own working through TR -> APL-DT -> HI-P on the lower chain, with EXP-DT/C-INFO central hubs.
